title: Resident Share of Therapy Visits and Fees — Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services
content:
The central business office charges a resident's share of **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** visits and fees on the following basis.

## Charging clause

> What the resident owes for a visit depends on the tier: under Part B, any unmet part of the year's shared Part B deductible, then the Part B coinsurance percent of the rest of the allowed amount; under Medicare Advantage, the per-visit copay recorded from the plan's authorization; under Medical Assistance, the tier's resident copay, which is zero for a nursing facility resident; and under private pay, the evaluation or re-evaluation fee, the unit rate per unit, or the group session charge. A late cancellation fee applies only to the private pay tier. Each visit is charged once per charge type, rounded half up to the cent.

## The clause by tier

| Tier | What the resident is charged for a visit | Charge type |
|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy and Speech-Language Pathology Plans of Care | First, any unmet part of the year's shared Part B deductible; then 20 percent of the rest of the visit's allowed amount | Part B deductible; Part B coinsurance |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | The per-visit copay recorded from the plan's authorization | Medicare Advantage copay |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | The tier's resident copay, $0.00 for a nursing facility resident | — |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | The evaluation fee of $165.00, the re-evaluation fee of $95.00, $48.00 per timed unit, or $38.00 per group session | Private rate |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care, late-cancelled or missed visit | The late cancellation fee of $35.00 | Late cancellation fee |

The Part B coinsurance is 20 percent in the three Medicare Part B tiers and 0 percent elsewhere. The late cancellation fee applies only to the Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care; it is $0.00 in every other tier.

## How each amount is worked out

1. **Part B deductible.** The year's shared Part B deductible is the one annual deductible met across every Part B service at the center. The charge is whatever part of it remains unmet, taken from the visit's allowed amount.
2. **Part B coinsurance.** The coinsurance is the Part B coinsurance percent multiplied by the rest of the allowed amount — the allowed amount less the deductible charged on that visit — rounded half up to the cent.
3. **Private units.** The units billed are multiplied by the unit rate, and the product is rounded half up to the cent.
4. **Rounding.** Every charge row is rounded half up to the cent on its own.

## Once per charge type

Each visit, or late cancellation, is charged once per charge type. This is judged on the system's record of the charges already posted naming that visit or cancellation, before the charge is posted. A charge is recorded naming the visit or cancellation, its charge type, the date of service, the amount (a positive figure) and the posting date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Hypothetical visit | Working | Resident charge |
|---|---|---|
| Part B visit; allowed amount $113.47; $37.19 of the year's shared deductible still unmet | Deductible $37.19; rest of the allowed amount $76.28; 20 percent of $76.28 is $15.256, rounded half up | Part B deductible $37.19 and Part B coinsurance $15.26 |
| Part B visit; allowed amount $87.63; deductible already met | 20 percent of $87.63 is $17.526, rounded half up | Part B coinsurance $17.53 |
| Medicare Advantage visit; copay recorded from the authorization $22.75 | The recorded copay | Medicare Advantage copay $22.75 |
| Medical Assistance visit for a nursing facility resident | Resident copay | $0.00 |
| Private-pay treatment visit billed at 3 units | 3 multiplied by $48.00 | Private rate $144.00 |
| Private-pay visit cancelled late | Late cancellation fee | $35.00 |
